## The cost to writes (300 loaded groups, 10 writes a second each)

Latency is the committed answer at the client minus the write's planned time, in ms. "Before": the last 8 s before the hand-back. "During": writes planned while it ran. "Caught": writes on a group planned from 50 ms before its own transfer began to 200 ms after it ended. "Others": writes during it on groups not in a transfer then. "After": 1-6 s after it ended. For pace none (no hand-back), "during" is a 10 s window at the same point.

## The cost to writes, as extra latency over the steady state before the hand-back (results/load.jsonl)

Per run: the class's p50 / p99 minus the base, in ms (the max is shown as it is: a few hundred caught writes and 24,000 "before" writes do not compare at the max); then the median over runs, range in brackets. The base is the median "before" p50 / p99 / max over every run of the same scenario and R (all paces): one run's own "before" window can hold a collector pause or the boot's tail (one cold run at 10,000 had a "before" p99 of 330 ms). The control row (pace none) shows the box's own noise: its "others during" is a 10 s window at the same point with no hand-back. "Caught" is F-05's case (a write that meets its own group's transfer). "Others" are writes during the hand-back on groups not in a transfer then: the cost of the members' busy thread. "Moved by" is when the last loaded group was handed back, from the hand-back's start. "Even, no load" is the median time to even out from handback.jsonl (random order), for the same scenario, R and pace.

Bases (median "before" over all runs, ms, p50 / p99 / max): cold 1,000: 1.8 / 6.0 / 27.4; cold 10,000: 1.9 / 6.6 / 19.7; cold 100,000: 1.9 / 10.2 / 43.6; restart 1,000: 1.8 / 5.9 / 19.3; restart 10,000: 1.9 / 7.4 / 26.1; restart 100,000: 1.9 / 8.7 / 28.8

Summed over all runs of each configuration.
